s: Sheyyihyeh haqqiddush bimqom seudda ubo y"b seipim: en qiddush ella bimqom seudda, sheim qiddesh bebayit zeh veakal bebayit acher, ben shehaya dato mittechilla leekol babbayit haacher, ben sheqqiddesh al daat leekol bebayit zeh veachar kak nimlak leekol bebayit acher — lo yatza yede chobato baqqiddush harishon, vetzarik lachazor uleqaddesh qodem sheyyokal babbayit haacher, ben baqqiddush shel layla uben baqqiddush shel yom, shenneemar "veqarata lashshabbat oneg", vedareshu chakamim: bimqom oneg seuddat shabbat — sham tehe qeriat haqqiddush. Veen tzarik lomar sheim qiddesh velo saad acharayv kelal shello yatza yede chobat qiddush:

Vaapillu bebayit echad mecheder lecheder, sheqqiddesh becheder echad al daat leekol becheder zeh, veachar kak nimlak leekol becheder acher, veken mibbayit laaliyya, o mealiyya labbayit — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Benimlak, abal im kesheqqiddesh haya dato leekol becheder acher — en tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh im shene hachadarim hem bebayit echad. Veken mibbayit laaliyya, o mealiya labbayit (umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob shello laasot ken, sheyyesh choleqim al zeh). Abal mibbayit lebayit, o mibbayit lechatzer — eno moil mah shehaya bedato mittechilla al kak, vetzarik lachazor uleqaddesh, kemo shennitbaer. Umikkol maqom, im bishat akilato sham yakol hu lirot mishsham et meqomo sheqqiddesh bo, apillu derek challon, vaapillu miqtzat meqomo — yesh omerim shezzeh niqra qiddush bimqom seudda, sheshshene meqomot ellu kemaqom echad leinyan qiddush, kemo shehen kemaqom echad leinyan tzerup lezimmun, kemo shennitbaer besimman qtz"h. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq:

Mippinna lepinna bebayit echad, sheqqiddesh bezavit zo al daat leekol kan veachar kak nimlak leekol bezavit acheret beoto bayit veoto cheder, vaapillu hu teraqlin gadol — en tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh, shekkol hacheder nechshab maqom echad. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob shello laasot ken, sheyyesh choleqim al zeh:

Vesukka shehi betok habbayit ap al pi shemmechitztzot hassukka mapsiqot ben chalal hassukka lachalal habbayit — enah kecheder bipne atzmo, kevan sheen mechitztzot asuyot letashmish ella leshem mitzvat sukka, ulepikak im qiddesh babbayit veachar kak nimlak leekol bassukka, o lehepek — en tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh, shehare zeh kemo mippinna lepinna. Abal im mechitztzot habbayit mapsiqot ben chalal habbayit lachalal hassukka ap al pi sheppetach habbayit patuach lassukka — hare zeh kemecheder lecheder. (Veim en hassukka semuka labbayit ella avir hechatzer mapsiq benehem — hare zeh kemibbayit lebayit o mibbayit lechatzer):

Tzarik leekol bimqom haqqiddush lealtar achar haqqiddush, abal im lo akal ad leachar zeman — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor uleqaddesh qodem sheyyokal. Veen chilluq ben zeman qatzar lizman arok. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemittechilla kesheqqiddesh lo haya bedato leekol miyyad, abal im haya bedato leekol miyyad, ella sheereo ones shello akal ad leachar zeman — yatza yede chobato, veeno tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh kesheokel bimqom haqqiddush. Vehu shello yatza mimmaqom zeh mishsheqqiddesh ad sheyyokal, abal im yatza benetayim — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh. Veim mittechilla kesheqqiddesh haya bedato shello leekol ad leachar zeman, vaapillu haya bedato gam ken shello yokal bebayit zeh ella bebayit acher, veachar kak nimlak veakal miyyad bimqom haqqiddush — eno tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh:

Yakol adam leqaddesh laacherim ap al pi sheeno okel immahem, veen bazeh mishshum qiddush shello bimqom seudda, kevan shellehashshomeim hayyotzeim yede chobatan hu meqom seudda. Umikkol maqom, kevan shehu eno yotze yede chobato beqiddush zeh, veken im kebar qiddesh leatzmo bimqom seuddato, kevan shehu eno tzarik leqiddush zeh — en lo leqaddesh laacherim lekattechilla, ella im ken hem enam yodeim leqaddesh beatzmam. Ukesheadayin lo qiddesh leatzmo — tzarik lizzaher shello yitom kelum mikkos shel qiddush zeh, sheasur lo litom ad sheyyeqaddesh bimqom seuddato. Veap al pi ken yakol lebarek lahem "bore peri haggapen" shebbeqiddush zeh. Ap al pi shebbirkat hanehennin en mi sheeno neheneh yakol lehotzi acherim ap al pi sheenan yodeim lebarek, mikkol maqom birkat "bore peri haggapen" shel qiddush, ben shel layla ben shel yom, veken birkat "hammotzi" keshemmeqaddesh al happat — enan domot lishar birkat hannehenin, hoil vehen choba, ukemo shennitbaer besimman qs"z:

Horu haggeonim shezzeh sheameru chakamim: en qiddush ella bimqom seudda — en tzarik sheyyigmor sham kol seuddato, ella apillu im akal kezayit, o apillu kezayit mechameshet hamminim shemmebarekim alehem "bore mine mezonot", o sheshshata rebiit yayin millebad kos haqqiddush — yotze bazeh yede qiddush bimqom seudda. Veyakol leekol achar kak hasseudda bemaqom acher, ben miyyad ben leachar zeman. Veeno tzarik lebarek al hakkos qodem otah seudda, ben ballayla ben bayyom, shekkevan shekkebar yatza yede qiddush bimqom seudda — hare seudda zo haacheret doma lisudda shelishit shel shabbat sheen tzarik lebarek al hakkos lepaneha:

Abal im akal perot, apillu harbeh, veken im shata shear mashqim, ap al pi shehem "chamar medina" — eno yotze yede qiddush bimqom seudda, lepi shehayyayin soed halleb, vachameshet hamminim niqraim mazon, lekak hem reuyim lehiqqare alehem shem seudda, mah sheen ken bishar mashqim uperot:

Yesh omerim sheapillu shata rebiit yayin mikkos haqqiddush — yotze bazeh yede qiddush bimqom seudda, velo hitzriku seudda bimqom qiddush ella keshello shata rebiit shelema ella rob rebiit. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem leet hatztzorek, kegon beqiddush shebbebet hakkeneset, o mila, veen sham qatan lehashqoto mikkos shel beraka — yishteh gadol rebiit shelema veyitkavven latzet yede chobato, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"t. (Umikkol maqom, im epshar tob sheyyishteh od rebiit shelema millebad rob rebiit sheyyotze bo yede chobat qiddush, kede latzet ledibre hakkol):

Im qiddesh betok beto veshama shekeno haqqiddush mimmennu keshehu betok bayit shello veshulchano aruk lepanayv leekol miyyad beoto maqom — yotze bo yede chobato, shehare hu shomea bimqom seuddato. Veap al pi shehamqaddesh hu bemaqom acher — en bekak kelum. Vehu sheyyitkavven hamqaddesh lehotzio yede chobato, veyitkavven hu latzet bishmia zo. Vaapillu lekattechilla yakol adam leqaddesh bebeto kede sheyyishmeu shekenayv veyetzeu yede chobatan, vaapillu im hu eno okel adayin veeno yotze beqiddush zeh, ella shemmeqaddesh bishbil shekenayv sheenan yodeim leqaddesh:

Mi shebbeto samuk lebet hakkeneset veshama haqqiddush betok beto mehashsheliach tzibbur shemmeqaddesh bebet hakkeneset, ap al pi shemmitkavven latzet bo — lo yatza, lepi shebbizman hazzeh sheen lanu orechim hashshobetim etzel bet hakkeneset — en hashsheliach tzibbur mitkavven kelal lehotzi shum adam beqiddush zeh, veeno meqaddesh ella mechamat hamminhag:

Lekattechilla tzarik leekol seuddat hallayla bemaqom shehannerot doleqot. Veap im okelah mibbeod yom — en lo leekol bechatzer, ap im neheneh sham yoter mippene haavir, o mippene hazzebubim. Abal im hu mitztaer harbeh babbayit mippene hashsharab o mippene hazzebubim — yakol leqaddesh veleekol bechatzer ap al pi sheeno roeh hannerot, shehannerot leoneg nitztavvu velo letzaar. Raq sheyyizzaher sheyyihyu hannerot arukkim sheyyidlequ ad hallayla, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"g, ayyen sham:
